video_title: What it’s like to go on a Road Trip as an NBA Player…

quotes.speaker: Ryan
quotes.summary_phrase: Ryan on his role as a strength coach for the Bulls
quotes.excerpt: trying to keep you healthy, keep you at the pound for pound strength champ in the weight room.
quotes.quote: I am excited to be here, having a new job, learning the NBA ropes, trying to keep you healthy, keep you at the pound for pound strength champ in the weight room.

quotes.speaker: Zach LaVine
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach LaVine on his mindset before scoring 30 points
quotes.excerpt: you get your mind right, you get your body right, you sit here, get your thoughts all going.
quotes.quote: Right now we are not feeling good, but before the game, you get your mind right, you get your body right, you sit here, get your thoughts all going, and all of a sudden, you got 30.

quotes.speaker: Torrey Craig
quotes.summary_phrase: Torrey Craig on the importance of observing the game from the bench
quotes.excerpt: when you sit on the bench long enough, you observe the game and you see areas need to be fixed.
quotes.quote: When you sit on the bench long enough, you observe the game and you see areas that need to be fixed. So when you come in the game, you are feeling those boys.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Vucevic
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Vucevic on the key to his All-Star level performance
quotes.excerpt: my teammates putting me in the right spots.
quotes.quote: My teammates putting me in the right spots.

quotes.speaker: Josh Giddey
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Giddey on the difficulty of getting camera time

quotes.quote: You can't get everybody camera time.
